corrections: The R3-hardening record's checks.unit_and_integration described a 398-test run made before the reviewer's fixes and a 22-test re-run after them; it did not establish a full unit-suite pass on the final source of aff2778. This record's unit run is the entire suite on the frozen candidate.

The R3-hardening record's deviations list said 'the one flaky test in the final full run is listed in full_playwright'; the final full run recorded there had 0 flaky tests (the flaky and failed tests belonged to the earlier runs it also describes). The statement was stale and is withdrawn here; the original file is not edited.

Four private-marker forms survived aff2778's redaction and reached plannerRequest (independent reproduction, confirmed here against the imported functions before the fix): '**private:**' with the payload on the next line, '(private: … [note] …)' cut at the square bracket, a nested [private] span whose inner close exposed the outer tail, and Arabic markers with composed prefixes (بالخاص, فالخاص). Privacy hardening was therefore not complete at aff2778; this record covers the fix.
deviations: Privacy hardening is not marked complete: the redaction now passes every known canary and the structural exclusion holds, but production acceptance (signed-in journey) has not been performed, so backlog tasks stay at 'deployed' with no production_accepted stage.
